To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have demonstrated that heterologous expression of xylanases from A. cellulolyticus improves the ability of C.bescii to grow and metabolize xylan substrates.
heterologous expression of A. cellulolyticus xylanases in C. bscii resulted in a dramatic increase in growth on xylan and a modest increase in extracellular xylanase activity.
we introduced two xylanas into Caldicellulosiuptor besci and this resulted in improved growth on xylan.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a consolidated process for the production of commodity chemicals from renewable biomass feedstocks.
the development of an improved C. besciicellulose-deconstructing exoproteome.
the development of a microbial platform that can be used to convert plant biomass to commodity chemicals and biofuels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the ability to grow on xylan was enhanced in a strain of C. bscii expressing xylanases from A. cellulolyticus, suggesting that the ability to use xylan as a substrate for growth is enhanced when xylan is degraded in situ.
the introduction of two xylanase genes from Acidothermus into Caldicellulosiuptor besci increased the ability of the organism to grow on xylan substrata.
the heterologous expression of xylanases from A. cellulolyticus enhanced the ability of C.bescii to use a xylan substrate and to grow on xylan.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the heterologous expression of xylanases from A. cellulolyticus enhanced the ability of C.bescii to use these substrates for growth.
heterologous expression of the xylanases from A. cellulolyticus enhanced growth and deconstruction of xylan substrates in C. bescalii.
the introduction of xylanases from A. cellulolyticus into C. besciii increased the ability of C.bescii to grow and metabolize xylan.
The main takeaway from our work is that
even a modest increase in the activity and/or the amount of xylanases can have a significant impact on the ability of C.bescii to use plant xylan.
heterologous expression of xylanases from other species can enhance the ability of Caldicellusolusiruptor beseii to grow on xylan.
the ability of C5 and C 6 substrates to be converted to products of interest is improved by heterologous expression of xylanases from A. cellulolyticus.
